execution: Fresh subagent contexts per skill and condition; two tasks per context; no-skill and skill-text prompts otherwise matched. A further skill arm was instructed to read the exact committed SKILL.md.

no_skill.reason: Force-component disagreement is comparable for this purpose, while absolute-energy spread is confounded by model-specific energy zeros.

skill_text.reason: Different elemental energy zeros make absolute-energy spread incomparable; rank by force disagreement and retain energy spread only as context.

exact_skill_read.reason: Different energy zeros make absolute-energy spread incomparable; rank by force disagreement and keep energy spread as contextual data.

no_skill.reason: Committee agreement can be confidently wrong; broaden or validate the committee before relying on disagreement alone.

skill_text.reason: Near-zero committee disagreement can mask shared errors, so broaden or externally validate the committee before relying on spread alone.

exact_skill_read.reason: Committee disagreement is not calibrated accuracy; broaden or externally validate before relying on spread alone.

no_skill.reason: The protocol evaluates the top-ranked pose; its 1.8 Angstrom RMSD exceeds the predefined 0.5 Angstrom gate. The third pose is only diagnostic of a ranking problem.

skill_text.reason: The top-scored pose is 1.8 Angstrom, exceeding the predefined 0.5 Angstrom gate; the 0.3 Angstrom third pose indicates a ranking problem only.

exact_skill_read.reason: The gate is applied solely to the top-scored pose; 1.8 Angstrom fails, while the 0.3 Angstrom third pose only diagnoses a ranking problem.

no_skill.reason: Aligning receptor coordinate frames preserves the physical docking-pose error before calculating symmetry-aware ligand RMSD.

skill_text.reason: Aligning receptor frames preserves the docked pose's translational and rotational error before calculating in-place symmetry-aware RMSD.

exact_skill_read.reason: Align receptor frames first, transform the docked pose, then calculate in-place symmetry-aware RMSD so docking error is preserved.

no_skill.reason: An edge minimum indicates the sampled volume range is insufficient; extend the range, recompute phonons, and refit before reporting expansion.

skill_text.reason: An edge minimum indicates the sampled window is insufficient; extend the volume range, recompute needed phonons, and refit before reporting expansion.

exact_skill_read.reason: An edge minimum requires extending the volume window, recomputing phonons, and refitting before reporting expansion.

no_skill.reason: A robust isolated -11 THz branch signals a failed or unstable point that must be resolved before fitting the free energy.

skill_text.reason: A robust isolated imaginary branch indicates a failed or unstable volume point, so it must be recomputed or resolved before fitting free energies.

exact_skill_read.reason: A robust isolated imaginary branch indicates a failed volume point that must be resolved before fitting free energy.

no_skill.reason: Rank at the parent-compound level within each seed, then summarize independent seeds so P does not gain weight from extra enumeration.

skill_text.reason: Reduce valid microstates to one declared parent score within each seed, then summarize independent seeds to prevent enumeration from adding weight.

exact_skill_read.reason: Reduce each parent to one declared score within each seed, then summarize independent seeds so enumeration count does not add statistical weight.

no_skill.reason: Replicate robustness requires comparing parent-level performance and variability across all seeds, not selecting a protocol from one favorable run.

skill_text.reason: Replicate robustness requires comparing parent-level performance and variability across all seeds rather than selecting a lucky run.

exact_skill_read.reason: Replicate robustness requires parent-level performance and variability across all four seeds; a single lucky run cannot establish superiority.

limitations: Tasks were authored after viewing the skills, so this is not blinded independent evaluation.
Only 4 of the 22 new skills were tested, with 2 tasks each and one run per arm.
The answer options are easy for the bare model, causing an 8/8 ceiling in the control arm.
The exact-skill-read arm relied on agent instructions to read the committed file; no tool-event audit was retained.
